scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Apo.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Player
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Yes, Lola?

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: I have lived many years here in America. But my heart still misses my home. I miss Aklan. I miss the rice fields. I miss the sound of people speaking Aklanon.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: When I was young, my sister and I ran in the fields. We laughed. We fought. Then we forgave each other. Life was simple, but it was happy.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Nahidlaw gid ako sa Aklan.
Choose how to answer Grandma.

choices.label: That sounds beautiful, Lola. I want to know more about your home.
I do not understand Aklanon yet, but I want to listen.
I do not think I can learn that language, Lola.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: That makes me happy, Apo. A language is not only words. It is also memory.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: That is okay. Listening is the first step.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Do not say that too soon. You can learn slowly. One word at a time.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Tanan kita makatuon.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Player
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Lola, can I really learn Aklanon?

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Yes. If your heart is open, your mind will follow.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Father
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Mom, I heard you talking. I have an idea.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: What is it, son?

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Father
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: What if we visit Aklan this summer?

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Aklan?

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Father
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Yes. Your hometown.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: I would love that. With the time I have left, I want to see my home again.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Gusto ko magbalik sa Aklan.
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.translation: I want to return to Aklan.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Choose how to answer the plan.

choices.label: Then let us go, Lola. I will go with you.
It sounds far, but I will try.
Do we really have to go?

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: Thank you, Apo. This means so much to me.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Father
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: It is far, but we will go together.

scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_grandma_s_terrace.text: You do not understand yet. But maybe when we get there, you will.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Yes. That is Aklan saying hello.
You hear a new word from Grandma.
Choose how to practice the word.

choices.label: Kauli. Did I say it right, Lola?
What does kauli mean again?
That word is hard.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: It may sound hard now, but your tongue will learn.

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Rose
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: Ay! Haman kamo nag-agi sa likod it van?
scene_3_airport_parking_area.translation: Hey! Why did you walk behind the van?

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Player
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: I do not understand what you said, but you almost hit us!

choices.label: Sorry. We did not see the van moving.
Let us just be careful next time.
You were the one driving badly!

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Rose
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: Hm. Fine. Sorry too. The parking area is crowded.

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Rose
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: Good. Just watch where you walk.

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Rose
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: Wow. You just arrived and already want to fight?

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: Come, come. You must be tired and hungry.

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Father
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: Hello, Auntie Susan. Long time no see.

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Rose
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: Not yet? So there is still hope.

choices.label: Maybe you can teach me.
I only know a few words.
I do not need your help.

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Rose
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: Hm. Good answer. Maybe I will teach you.

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Rose
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: Then we start with easy words.

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Rose
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: Fine. Then ask the road signs to teach you.

scene_3_airport_parking_area.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_3_airport_parking_area.text: Be kind, Apo. You are a guest here.

scene_4_inside_the_van.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_4_inside_the_van.text: We will eat first. You all look hungry.

scene_4_inside_the_van.speaker: Player
scene_4_inside_the_van.text: Lola, what did Auntie Susan say earlier?

scene_4_inside_the_van.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_4_inside_the_van.text: She asked if you were hungry.

scene_4_inside_the_van.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_4_inside_the_van.text: In Aklanon, we say: Gutom ka?

choices.label: Huo, gutom ako. = Yes, I am hungry.
Medyo gutom ako. = I am a little hungry.
Uwa ako gutom. = I am not hungry.

scene_4_inside_the_van.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_4_inside_the_van.text: Good! We will feed you well.

scene_4_inside_the_van.speaker: Rose
scene_4_inside_the_van.text: A little hungry? After that long trip? Impossible.

scene_4_inside_the_van.speaker: Father
scene_4_inside_the_van.text: You are not hungry? I am starving.

choices.label: Thanks, Rose. That was easy to understand.
Okay. Huo means yes. Uwa means no.
I already knew that.

scene_4_inside_the_van.speaker: Rose
scene_4_inside_the_van.text: You are welcome. See? I can be nice.

scene_4_inside_the_van.speaker: Rose
scene_4_inside_the_van.text: Then genius, say "I am hungry" in Aklanon.

scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.speaker: Rose
scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.text: Maayad nga adlaw means good day.

scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.speaker: Restaurant Worker
scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.translation: What do you want to eat?

scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.speaker: Rose
scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.text: She is asking what you want to eat.

choices.label: Can you help me order in Aklanon?
I will just have what Lola is having.
I cannot read this. This is too hard.

scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.speaker: Rose
scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.text: Sure. Say, "Gusto ko it kan-on." It means, "I want rice."

scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.text: Good choice. I know what is delicious.

scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.speaker: Rose
scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.text: It is only hard because it is new. Calm down.

scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.text: We start small. One word at a time.

scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_5_small_restaurant_near_kalibo.text: Very good! Soon you will speak like us.

scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.text: Sister, why did you come home now?

scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.text: I missed home. I also want my family to know where I came from.

scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.text: Yes. I want to visit places from my childhood. I want my apo to learn Aklanon. I want him to understand our people, even just a little.

choices.label: Okay, Teacher Rose. Please teach me.
Let us see how this goes.
You? My teacher?

scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.speaker: Rose
scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.text: Fair enough. I will start easy.

scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.speaker: Rose
scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.text: Yes, me. Unless you want the menu to teach you.

scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.speaker: Rose
scene_6_restaurant_table_conversation.text: I am patient, Lola. A little.

scene_7_first_aklanon_lesson.speaker: Rose
scene_7_first_aklanon_lesson.text: Lesson one. These are very easy words.

choices.label: Salamat, Rose.
Salamat.
Do I have to say it?

scene_7_first_aklanon_lesson.speaker: Rose
scene_7_first_aklanon_lesson.text: You are welcome. That sounded nice.

scene_7_first_aklanon_lesson.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_7_first_aklanon_lesson.text: Yes, Apo. Saying thank you is always good.

scene_8_chapter_ending.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_8_chapter_ending.text: This place changed. But it still feels like home.

scene_8_chapter_ending.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_8_chapter_ending.text: I am happy, Apo. Very happy.

scene_8_chapter_ending.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_8_chapter_ending.text: Tomorrow, we start your wish list.

scene_8_chapter_ending.speaker: Rose
scene_8_chapter_ending.text: Yes. You need to survive Aklan.
Choose your final response for Chapter 1.

choices.label: I am ready. Teach me more.
I will try my best.
This is going to be difficult.

scene_8_chapter_ending.speaker: Rose
scene_8_chapter_ending.text: Good. Tomorrow, we visit the market.

scene_8_chapter_ending.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_8_chapter_ending.text: Remember this, Apo: language is a bridge. When you learn even one word, you take one step closer to people.
